data.name: EquivalentStrikesDescription
data.value: Option strikes of an underlying (QQQ, NDX, SPY, SPX) drawn on the chart of its future.

data.name: PairDescription
data.value: Fills in the factor and the strike ladder of a known pair. Custom changes nothing.

data.name: NameDescription
data.value: Written in front of every strike.

data.name: FactorDescription
data.value: Chart points per point of the underlying: the ratio between the index and its ETF, or 1 for the index itself.

data.name: BasisDescription
data.value: Added after the factor: what the future is worth over the index. Negative below it.

data.name: UnderlyingPriceDescription
data.value: Price of the underlying right now, from its own chart or from the option chain.

data.name: IndexPriceDescription
data.value: Price of the index right now. Optional: with it the factor and the basis are both exact, because the factor is the ratio between the index and the underlying.

data.name: SolveDescription
data.value: What a single price of the underlying computes. Ignored when the index price is set, which gives both.

data.name: ApplyAnchorDescription
data.value: Maps the prices above onto the last price of the chart. Clears itself.

data.name: StrikeSpacingDescription
data.value: Distance between strikes, in points of the underlying.

data.name: MajorEveryDescription
data.value: Strikes that are a multiple of this value get the major line. Zero draws them all alike.

data.name: MaximumLinesDescription
data.value: Above this count the spacing is doubled, then multiplied by five, and so on, instead of covering the chart.

data.name: MinorLinesDescription
data.value: Draw the strikes that are not major.

data.name: LabelsDescription
data.value: Write the strike over its line.

data.name: LabelsOnLeftDescription
data.value: By default they go against the price scale.

data.name: PriceInLabelDescription
data.value: Adds the chart price the strike maps to.

data.name: EquivalenceDescription
data.value: Reads the last price of the chart as a price of the underlying, in a corner.

data.name: IndexLayerShowDescription
data.value: Also draws the strikes of the index behind the ETF (NDX for QQQ, SPX for SPY) with their own style. It uses the basis of the pair, which is exact when the anchor had both quotes.

data.name: IndexSpacingDescription
data.value: Distance between the index strikes that are drawn, in index points. Usually only the round ones are worth it: 100 for NDX, 25 for SPX.

data.name: IndexLabelsOnLeftDescription
data.value: Writes the index labels on the side opposite the ETF labels, so each side reads a single instrument.

data.name: EquivalencePositionDescription
data.value: Where the equivalence of the last price is written. Next to the price, it follows the price along the scale.
